callable-boundaries-for-the-model-invest.text: Callable boundaries for the model investigation.
As a reviewer, I want changes to call signatures distinguished from changes to the meaning of an accepted law.

planning-stage-contract.text: This is an investigation specification. No production function signature is changed by planning. New hypothetical Lean signatures are frozen in this file by the ticket owner after the authority/impact inventory and before the commit owner implements them. An unresolved semantic choice stays a question; inventing a complete replacement signature now would prejudge that investigation.
The following existing signatures identify the affected boundaries; they are not instructions to rewrite them:

The candidate's signatures must name all identity, hash-function, ledger-premise and observation inputs explicitly, with pure results. Record any serialization/driver surface changes before implementing them. Reuse the generic driver surface where its semantics suffice; do not add per-theorem expected-result projections.
This staged signature freeze is a planned output of investigation, not a claim that the production design is already specified.

bound-signature-inventory.text: The six boundaries above are traced individually in impact.md, together with the application registry/control dependencies. Their definitions and source hashes bind the accepted base; runtime declaration checks elaborate their current types. The candidate interfaces below are frozen for the hypothetical statement stage; accepted signatures remain unchanged. The registry-independent ledger script/history vocabulary remains unavailable at this base and is not replaced with a local ledger layer. Questions records the decisions needed before that freeze.

frozen-hypothetical-identity-surface.text: The isolated Lake project at investigations/741-no-pin/ requires the unchanged root from ../... Namespace NoPin owns Identity.lean (pure definitions), Statements.lean (hypotheses with sorry), Witnesses.lean (satisfying instances), Mutants.lean (falsifications) and Report.lean (compiled inventory). check.py reconciles the report with statement and mutant ledgers. Accepted signatures and drivers remain unchanged.

Derivation order: release → application policy → state policy; independently seed → state name; then complete registry asset → role assets and approvals. No later output is an earlier input. Hash : List Nat → Nat and Codec : Preimage → List Nat are explicit parameters; tagged structural natural-number encoding makes no Cardano byte claim.

Mutation.none is the candidate. Other selectors flip exactly one named atomic guard and exist only for the mutant ledger. The four Role constructors and other public predicates supply the inversion inventory; the compiled constructors determine its extent. Name-only safety is marked rejected and expected refutable, separately from stated hypotheses. No accepted serialization changes.

frozen-application-held-termination-surf.text: These are hypothetical signatures for the application-held statement stage. They neither change accepted signatures nor establish the unresolved combined settlement promise. All observations are explicit inputs. The minimal identity TxView and its existing statements remain unchanged.

New theorem bodies remain sorry. Every antecedent gets a satisfying executed instance, every selector is a single atomic guard flip in the same definition, and the public-case inventory is derived from compiled constructors. Ordinary funding, fee, observation authenticity and policy coupling remain premises. Economic-only availability is distinguished from the held composed availability claim.
